input.summary: Plunge the lit B lane to light the spinner and advance Strike. Repeat the spinner for 1,000 per spin. Use safe trips up top to build 5x and a 30,000 Strike.

steps.text: Plunge the top B lane while its white Automatic Strike lamp is on. It lights the left spinner for the rest of the ball.
modeNotes: B lane: Scores and advances the held Strike value when the white lamp is on. The lamp can stay on or alternate with switch hits.
Any B-lane collect lights the spinner, even when Automatic Strike is off.

steps.text: Trap on the right flipper and repeat the lit left spinner for 1,000 per spin.
modeNotes: Spinner: It scores 10 per spin when unlit and 1,000 when lit. Its lit state ends at the drain.

steps.text: When control is lost or the spinner is not available, use the right orbit to return the ball to A-B-C.
Complete A-B-C repeatedly. Prefer B whenever the spinner is unlit or Automatic Strike is on.
modeNotes: First A-B-C completion: Lights 2x bonus and the center bumper for 1,000 per hit.
Second completion: Lights 3x bonus. Third completion: Lights 5x bonus.
Fourth completion: Scores 5,000. Later completions light Special. Settings can combine or shift these awards.
Current A-B-C set progress carries across balls. Bonus X normally resets at the drain.

steps.text: Take the upper-right saucer only when it arrives naturally or its value and kickout are safe. It advances Strike and adds three bonus steps.
modeNotes: Strike value: 1,000, 5,000, 10,000, 15,000, 20,000, 30,000, then Special. It is held between balls.
After a Special collect, Strike returns to 30,000 and stays there.

steps.text: Keep the ball up top and repeat the lit spinner. Protect a large 29,000 base bonus at 5x.
modeNotes: Bonus: Lanes and SPARE targets add one step. The saucer adds three. Maximum is 29,000 at 5x, or 145,000.
Base bonus resets after each ball and cannot be collected during play.

fallback.title: Right orbit and A-B-C
fallback.when: Use this when the spinner is weak, rejects, or cannot be reached from a controlled right flipper.

steps.text: Repeat the right orbit to return the ball to the top.
Complete A-B-C for 2x, 3x, then 5x.
Use lit center-bumper and upper-saucer awards when they occur naturally.
Collect the built bonus without tilting.

alternatives.title: SPARE extra ball
alternatives.when: Use this only when extra balls are enabled or converted to useful points.

steps.text: Hit all five lit SPARE standups in one ball.
The first completion lights an alternating inlane for extra ball.
Collect the lit inlane before the ball drains. SPARE progress and its lit award reset at the drain.
Advance the held Strike value with lit B-lane, saucer, or ten-pin completion hits.
Complete A-B-C three times for 5x.
Score lanes and SPARE targets, plus safe upper-saucer entries, until base bonus reaches 29,000. Drain without tilting.

techniques.name: Center-lane skill plunge
techniques.instruction: Set the plunger for the B lane. Time the plunge when the white Automatic Strike lamp is on when that lamp alternates.

techniques.name: Saucer-kickout nudge
techniques.instruction: Watch the first saucer eject. Nudge before the ball reaches the center or a sling, and use the flipper only after its path is clear.

cautions.issue: The upper-saucer kickout can feed straight down the middle or into a sling.
cautions.response: Test one natural eject. Do not aim for the saucer until its return has a repeatable save.

cautions.issue: A ball can rim the saucer or lip out and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Do not assume a near-make is safe. Be ready before every saucer approach and eject.

cautions.issue: Bumper action and direct center-target rebounds can become uncontrolled.
cautions.response: Use the spinner and right orbit. Ignore the ten pin rollovers and standups unless a single safe hit completes an award.

input.simpleOverview: In Strikes and Spares, plunge the B lane to light the left spinner for the rest of the ball, then repeat that spinner for 1,000 per spin. Return through the right orbit to complete A-B-C three times for 5x Bonus, and let the upper-right saucer advance the held Strike value when its kickout is controlled.
input.overview: In Strikes and Spares, the B lane lights the left spinner, three A-B-C completions raise Bonus X to 5x, and the upper-right saucer advances the held Strike value. Repeat the 1,000-per-spin left spinner, use the right orbit to revisit A-B-C, and take natural saucer entries. Build 29,000 base bonus and protect the 145,000 end-of-ball collect.
